title: Director of Quality
text:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

**About the Role:**

**As Director of Quality, you’ll lead Helix’s quality department and drive the development of systems, practices, and people to ensure product excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. You’ll hire, train, and manage the team, own the quality system, and make it clear who is responsible for quality at every step.**

**You’ll report directly to the Chief Executive Officer, partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and our customers to build a proactive, scalable, and right-sized quality system that enables growth.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Systems Development**

* Develop and continuously improve a scalable Quality Management System aligned with AS9100 and customer requirements
* Lead departmental strategy, structure, and capital planning to support business growth
* Serve as ISO/AS Management Representative

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and mentor a team of 5+ quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians
* Develop people and build team capabilities in metrology, inspection, and quality engineering
* Foster a culture of collaboration and real-time problem-solving on the shop floor

**Customer & Compliance Management**

* Lead customer and supplier audits; own response and resolution of corrective actions
* Ensure documentation, compliance, and audit readiness
* Build trusted relationships with key customers and act as the face of Quality

**Quality Engineering & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with operators to implement in-process quality at the machine (not just post-process inspection)
* Drive root cause analysis, SPC implementation, and corrective actions to reduce scrap and improve first-pass yield
* Support new product introductions and ensure proper gauges, fixtures, and inspection plans are in place

**Internal Inspection & Production Support**

* Oversee first-piece, in-process, and final inspection plans
* Continuously simplify and optimize inspection methods to reduce bottlenecks without sacrificing quality

**What Success Looks Like**

* Promoting Operational Excellence by initiating and helping implement continuous improvement objectives.
* Maintaining a robust QMS system and compliance to AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards.
* Leading the company during customer audits and independent audits towards successful (re)certification.
* Lowering scrap and increasing first pass yield.
* Cross functional collaboration with Production and Engineering to help build quality into the process.
* Implementing solid Corrective Actions to reduce RMAs and DMRs.
* Establishing best practices for the Quality department and the organization as a whole

**Who You Are**

* A pragmatic quality leader who blends systems thinking with real-world shop floor experience
* Confident navigating between big-picture strategy and hands-on process improvement
* A builder of systems and people, able to lead a team and train on complex equipment
* Comfortable in a customer-facing role and able to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Committed to continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value across departments

**Qualifications:**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in manufacturing quality, preferably in machining-based environments
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards
* Experience leading customer and regulatory audits
* Proven people management skills
* Working knowledge of metrology, CMM, GD&T, and SPC tools
* Experience balancing compliance with operational efficiency

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Mechanical or technical degree
* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD)
* Six Sigma, Lean, or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA, CQM)
* Familiarity with vision systems, statistical software (e.g., Minitab), and automation of inspection processes

**About the Company:**

**Helix Linear Technologies designs and manufactures high-precision motion control systems for industries where performance matters most, like aerospace, medical devices, and industrial automation. We’re in a phase of strategic growth, investing in R&D, advanced equipment, and new product lines, including aerospace-grade ball screws.**

**Our clean, climate-controlled facility is built for precision, focus, and continuous improvement. At Helix, you’ll join a team that values ownership, technical excellence, and curiosity.**

**We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, a retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off and company holidays.**

**Helix Linear Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Due to U.S. export control laws, applicants must be U.S. persons (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).**

**Salary Description**

* **$115,000 - $135,000**
